prompt:
Write a client review left on a freelance platform for Noor Halden after this project.

Project facts (the only truth you may use):
title: Support ticket triage model
client: Kettlewell Support Co.
client_industry: SaaS
start: 2020-09
end: 2020-12
engagement: fixed
stack:

- Redis

  FastAPI, with nightly retraining run through a Celery worker on Redis.

- median routing time from 6 hours to 4 minutes

The review is from: Kettlewell Support Co.
Rating: 4.0 out of 5

Requirements:
- 2 to 5 sentences in the voice of a busy client, not a marketer.
- If the rating is below 4.5, include one honest complaint (communication, delays or scope).

text: Noor built a solid support ticket triage model for us and got it into production with FastAPI and PostgreSQL in a way that fit our setup. The classifier routes incoming helpdesk tickets to 14 queues, and the routing time dropped from 6 hours to 4 minutes; macro-F1 also improved to 0.88 from 0.62 under the old keyword rules. Communication was a bit uneven at times, which is why I’m not giving a perfect score, but the work itself was strong.
